title: A whole-site build about to end on a failed check while checks remain is steered to repair and check again, at most three times a turn
steps: S1: checkAgainStep over a log whose latest tracy_demo check failed with one check run.
S2: the same with a later check that passed; with five failed checks; with DEMO_CHECK_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED; with no check.
expect: S1: a system-reminder saying 4 of 5 checks remain.

tests: checkAgainStep: a build ending on a failed check with checks left is steered on; a pass, a spent budget or no check is not
